given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-UNDER-CAP
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP - 0.01
then: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-SUCCESS-BOUNDARY
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP
then: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and TXN-OVER-CAP
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the transfer total is DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP + 0.01
then: the customer sees: This transfer would exceed your daily transfer limit. Please wait until your limit resets or enter a smaller amount.

given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-BELOW
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the source balance is MIN_BALANCE - 0.01
then: the customer sees: This transfer cannot be completed because it would leave your account below the required minimum balance. Please enter a smaller amount.

given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-BOUNDARY
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the resulting source balance is MIN_BALANCE
then: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation

given: an authenticated Customer has fixtures ACC-001 and ACC-BAL-ABOVE
when: the Customer submits a synthetic transfer where the resulting source balance is MIN_BALANCE + 0.01
then: the transfer completes and the customer sees a successful synthetic transfer confirmation
